title: hedyotis centranthoides
intro: Hedyotis centranthoides, commonly known as Lian Qiao or Prickly Gentian, is a plant species native to China. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate cough, and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis centranthoides are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe the body and promote recovery. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
